sections.title: Wardrobe Ledger (§14A) — one outfit per story day
sections.md:
Hooks and Acts 1–3 are the problem days; Acts 4–6 after the product are the after days. Every worn beat shows a bare knee (shorts, a rolled trouser or a dress above the knee), and the strap is worn on bare skin.

| N-D1 | N | cream crew-neck T-shirt | rust-orange needlecord overshirt, open *(sheet: TH wardrobe lock)* | dark indigo jeans | tan leather lace-ups | a pencil behind the ear on HK2-02 only | rust / cream / indigo | TH-01…06, HK2-01/02, BR-057/058 |
| G-D1 | R1 Gail | grey marl T-shirt | faded lilac towelling dressing gown, open | navy cotton pyjama shorts to above the knee | sheepskin slippers | — | lilac / grey / navy | HK1-01, HK2-03, HK3-04, BR-003–BR-016, BR-032/033, BR-035 |
| G-D2 | R1 Gail | white broderie-anglaise short-sleeved blouse | — | wide-leg sage-green linen trousers, rolled above the knees for the test | tan leather sandals (the bunions show) | a thin gold watch | white / sage / tan | PR-037–BR-043, BR-047–BR-053 |
| K-D1 | R2 Ken | white polo shirt | tan cotton golf jacket, half zipped | stone chino shorts just above the knee | navy socks, brown brogues | grey tweed flat cap | tan / stone / grey | HK1-02, HK3-02, BR-017–BR-022 |
| K-D2 | R2 Ken | bottle-green short-sleeved polo | — | khaki chino shorts just above the knee | navy socks, brown brogues | the flat cap in his hand | green / khaki | BR-061b, PR-062 |
| J-D1 | R3 Joan | heather-purple fine-knit twinset | a camel wool coat outdoors (BR-028–BR-030) | grey pleated skirt just above the knee | beige slippers indoors · black low-heeled shoes outdoors | pearl stud earrings | purple / grey / camel | HK3-03, BR-024–BR-030 |
| J-D2 | R3 Joan | navy white-polka-dot cotton dress, just above the knee | coral cotton cardigan | bare legs | white canvas pumps | a straw handbag on her arm | navy / coral / white | BR-065 |
| one-offs | CL-01 clinician hand · SG-01 surgeon (§19B approachable, pale blue shirt, sleeves rolled) · WK-01/WK-02 walkers · DT-01 daughter, GS-01 grandson · CP-01 copy hands | each its own single day (D5) | | | | | | BR-009/015, PR-045, BR-026/046, BR-030, BR-064 |

**Novelty (§14A):** no outfit repeats across days, and none repeats the sheet wardrobe except N's TH lock and Joan's shape (cardigan over a dress, new colours).

## Next

1. **You:** check the seven plates on the board (Confirm or Fix).
2. **Me, then:** §22U for the narrator. First a `nano_banana_pro` voice-source image in the workroom, then two Kling 10s takes with `VOICE-NARR` → `voice_source.py` → the clone source. **You clone it in the ElevenLabs app** as `Regrets` (the §22U step-6 stop). Then the Eleven v3 TTS of HK1–HK3 + body in one request, the house cut, and your master listen.
3. Then the hooks one by one (step 6).
